blocks.title: new Segment()
blocks.reason: Paper overloads create one node with optional relative handles, including null/undefined/Size coercion. A Gleam Segment is an edge with endpoints, not a node. No native constructor equivalence asserted.

blocks.title: segment.reverse()
blocks.reason: Map the node and relative handles to a closed one-cubic subpath and reverse it. Reconstructed node/handle coordinates match the upstream literal on both targets. In-place mutation is not tested.

blocks.title: segment.clone()
blocks.reason: Paper clone has separate object identity and equal node geometry. Immutable Gleam values have no corresponding mutable node clone-identity operation.

blocks.title: segment.remove()
blocks.reason: Removing the middle Paper node leaves two coincident nodes, hence one zero-length edge. Node removal is outside the Gleam API; deleting an edge is not equivalent. This is an understood API difference, not a pending adapter or library failure.

blocks.title: segment.selected
blocks.reason: Selected control-point state belongs to the scene/editor object model and has no geometry-only counterpart.
